# Profitmaker Modules — LLM index

One-page reference for building a Profitmaker terminal **module** (an npm package
that adds widgets and/or backend services to a running terminal). Full docs:
`docs/modules.md`. Starting point: copy `templates/module-template/`.

A module is an npm package with the `profitmaker-module` keyword and a
`profitmaker` key in `package.json` (the manifest). It may ship a `frontend`
(widget bundle), a `backend` (Elysia plugin + services), or both. Host API
version: `TERMINAL_API_VERSION` = `1.0.0`; declare compatibility via
`profitmaker.minTerminalApi`.

## Manifest (package.json `profitmaker` key)

```jsonc
{
  "manifestVersion": 1,
  "id": "example",                       // ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ; used in URLs + widget types
  "displayName": "Example Module",
  "minTerminalApi": ">=1.0.0",
  "permissions": ["market-data", "storage", "jobs"], // declarative only, not enforced
  "frontend": {
    "entry": "dist/frontend/index.js",   // served at /modules/<id>/bundle.js
    "style": "dist/frontend/style.css",  // optional, /modules/<id>/style.css
    "widgets": [{ "type": "example.hello", "title": "Example Hello", "category": "modules" }]
  },
  "backend": { "entry": "dist/backend/index.js", "routes": ["/hello"] }
}
```

Permissions: `market-data | private-data | orders | network | storage | jobs`.
At least one of `frontend` / `backend` is required. See
`docs/modules.md#manifest-reference`.

## Frontend (`@profitmaker/module-sdk`)

Default-export a module built with `defineModule`. Widget types are
`<moduleId>.<widgetName>`; they appear under the **Modules** menu section.

```tsx
import { defineModule, useWidgetGroup, useMarketData, useModuleSocket, getTerminal } from '@profitmaker/module-sdk';
import type { WidgetDefinition, WidgetProps, WidgetSettingsProps } from '@profitmaker/module-sdk';

function HelloWidget({ widgetId, groupId, config, updateConfig }: WidgetProps) {
  const group = useWidgetGroup(groupId);                       // { exchange?, symbol?, market?, account?, isComplete }
  const { ticker } = useMarketData({                           // candles|trades|orderbook|ticker, reactive
    exchange: group.exchange ?? '', symbol: group.symbol ?? '',
    dataType: 'ticker', market: group.market, subscriberId: widgetId,
  });
  const socket = useModuleSocket('example');                   // Socket.IO to /m/example
  if (!group.isComplete) return <div className="text-terminal-muted">Pick an exchange & symbol.</div>;
  return <div className="text-terminal-text">{(config.label as string) ?? group.symbol}: {ticker?.last ?? '—'}</div>;
}

const hello: WidgetDefinition = {
  type: 'example.hello', title: 'Example Hello', icon: 'LineChart',
  category: 'modules', defaultSize: { width: 360, height: 220 }, // pixels
  Component: HelloWidget,
};

export default defineModule({ id: 'example', widgets: [hello] });
```

Key interfaces:

```ts
interface WidgetProps { widgetId: string; groupId?: string; config: Record<string, unknown>; updateConfig: (patch: Record<string, unknown>) => void; }
interface WidgetSettingsProps { widgetId: string; groupId?: string; }
interface WidgetDefinition { type: string; title: string; icon?: string; category?: string; defaultSize: { width: number; height: number }; showGroupSelector?: boolean; needsTransparentGroup?: boolean; Component: ComponentType<WidgetProps>; Settings?: ComponentType<WidgetSettingsProps>; HeaderActions?: ComponentType<{ widgetId: string }>; }
```

Terminal API (`window.__PROFITMAKER__` / `getTerminal()`):
`widgets.{register,registerMany,unregister}`, `stores.{useDataProviderStore,
useGroupStore, useDashboardStore, useSettingsDrawerStore}`, `hooks.{useWidgetGroup,
useMarketData, useModuleSocket}`, `api.fetch(path, init?)` (authed; pass the FULL
`/api/modules/<id>/...` path), `api.baseUrl`, `notify.{success,error,info}`.

Persist config from a `Settings` panel (it has no `updateConfig`):
`getTerminal().stores.useDashboardStore.getState().updateWidgetConfig(widgetId, patch)`.

Theming — use the host palette classes: `bg-terminal-bg`, `bg-terminal-widget`,
`bg-terminal-accent`, `text-terminal-text`, `text-terminal-muted`,
`border-terminal-border`. See `docs/modules.md#frontend-modules` and
`docs/theming.md`.

**Single React instance:** the vite preset aliases `react`/`react-dom`/`zustand`/
the SDK to host runtime shims — write normal imports; nothing is bundled. See
`docs/modules.md#the-single-react-instance-rule`.

## Backend (`@profitmaker/module-sdk`)

Default-export a `BackendModule`. **Routes are relative to root** — the host
mounts the plugin under `/api/modules/<id>` and strips that prefix.

```ts
import { Elysia } from 'elysia';
import type { BackendModule } from '@profitmaker/module-sdk';

const mod: BackendModule = {
  async start(ctx) {
    let n = (await ctx.storage.get<number>('count')) ?? 0;
    ctx.jobs.every(10_000, async () => { n++; await ctx.storage.set('count', n); ctx.io.emit('heartbeat', n); });
    const routes = new Elysia().get('/hello', () => ({ ok: true, id: ctx.id })); // -> /api/modules/<id>/hello
    return { routes };
  },
  async stop() {},
};
export default mod;
```

`BackendModuleContext`: `id`, `version`, `log.{info,warn,error}`, `routesPrefix`,
`io` (Socket.IO namespace `/m/<id>`), `ccxt.getInstance({ exchangeId, marketType?,
sandbox?, apiKey?, secret?, password? })`, `storage.{get,set,delete,all}`
(per-module JSON, survives disable), `jobs.{every,once}` (auto-cleared on stop),
`env.dataDir`. See `docs/modules.md#backendmodulecontext`.

## Build, dev-load, publish, install

```bash
bun install && bun run build          # -> dist/frontend/index.js (+ style.css), dist/backend/index.js
# dev-load (no publish), from packages/server:
DATABASE_URL=postgres://USER@localhost:5432/profitmaker API_TOKEN=test-token \
  PROFITMAKER_DEV_MODULES=/abs/path/to/module bun src/index.ts
npm publish                            # keep the profitmaker-module keyword
```

Management API (all `/api/modules/*` require Bearer auth; `/modules/*` assets are
public): `GET /api/modules`, `GET /api/modules/search?q=`,
`POST /api/modules/install {name,version?}`, `POST /api/modules/:id/enable|disable|upgrade`,
`DELETE /api/modules/:id`, `ALL /api/modules/:id/*` (dispatch),
`GET /modules/:id/bundle.js|style.css`.

Runtime model: `install`/`enable`/`disable` apply with no restart;
`upgrade`/`uninstall` set `pendingRestart` (Bun can't evict a loaded ES module).
See `docs/modules.md#runtime-model`. Full agent loop:
`templates/module-template/AGENTS.md`.
